project.title: nixin
project.tagline: A local RAW photo editor with a Rust core and GPUI-first desktop direction.

summary.short: nixin is a local RAW photo editor with a Rust processing core, a GPUI-first desktop direction, and an architecture kept independent enough to support a Flutter frontend later.
summary.long: The current scope uses embedded JPEG previews for RAW formats, supports exposure, temperature, contrast, subject and sky masks, LUTs, JPEG export, XMP basics, workplace import flows, and a responsive desktop workspace.

highlights: Masks, LUTs, JPEG export, and workplace management
